meta_description: 30A ESCAPES presents… “Shimmy By The Sea”! Just minutes from the sugar-white sands of West Panama City Beach, this dreamy vacation home has it all: 4 chic bedrooms with private baths, a chef’s kitchen, stylish interiors, and your very own private pool and outdoor
description_expanded: 30A ESCAPES presents… “Shimmy By The Sea”! Just minutes from the sugar-white sands of West Panama City Beach, this dreamy vacation home has it all: 4 chic bedrooms with private baths, a chef’s kitchen, stylish interiors, and your very own private pool and outdoor lounge. Perfect for family fun or a getaway with friends. Pure magic awaits—come see for yourself! Learn more below…👇*** HIGHLIGHTS ***Dive into your own private pool or lounge on the breezy patio—your ultimate chill zone awaits!A quick 6-minute shimmy gets you to the best beach access aroundSoak up the vibes in bright, open spaces decked out with chic, modern decor and elegant finishesCook up a storm in the fully-equipped chef’s kitchen, complete with spacious dining—perfect for feasts and funSleeps up to 12 guests in 4 gorgeously styled bedrooms, each rocking its own en-suite for max comfortPlenty of parking for your crew—roll in and relax!Eager to Read More?Here Are A Few Kind Words From Our Previous Guests:⭐"Shimmy By The Sea is the perfect beach getaway! With a private bathroom for each bedroom, stunning decor, and that fantastic pool, it truly felt like a luxury retreat." – Oleksandra⭐"This house was AMAZING! It was spacious and luxurious—perfect for a special girls’ weekend. Will definitely be back!" – Kim D.*** LIVING AREA ***Step into “Shimmy By The Sea,” where every corner exudes a playful coastal charm blended with professional, polished decor. Bright, airy spaces welcome you with a vibe that’s equal parts relaxing and refined. The open-concept living room is designed for both comfort and style, featuring cozy seating dressed in chic fabrics, tasteful accents, and an abundance of natural light streaming through large windows. A sleek flat-screen TV anchors the room, making it perfect for family movie nights or laid-back evenings after a day by the sea.Open-Concept Layout with Seamlessly Connected SpacesComfortable Sofa and Seating for RelaxationLarge Smart TV for movie nightsDirect Access to Outdoor Pool and Patio*** KITCHEN AND DINING ***The chef’s kitchen is a standout feature with professional-grade stainless steel appliances and a spacious island that doubles as a breakfast bar. Dine in style at the modern table designed for memorable meals and lively conversations.Chef’s Kitchen with Top-Quality AppliancesLarge Center Island with Bar Seating for 5Dining Table Comfortably Seats 8 GuestsWell-Equipped with Cooking Essentials and Elegant Pendant Lighting*** OUTDOOR PRIVATE OASIS ***Escape to your very own outdoor paradise, where relaxation meets a touch of magic! Dive into the crystal-clear pool or kick back on the tanning ledge with your favorite drink in hand—pure bliss. Host unforgettable barbecue nights on the spacious patio, or simply soak in the peaceful vibes of your fully fenced yard. Your dream oasis is calling—are you ready to answer?Sparkling Private Pool with Luxe Lounge Chairs and Tanning LedgeStylish Covered Patio Perfect for Dining and ChillingBackyard Grill Ready for Alfresco FeastsFully Enclosed Yard—Your Private Slice of Serenity*** BEDROOMS & BATHROOMS ***First FloorKing Guest Bedroom: A spacious retreat featuring a luxurious king-sized bed and a private en-suite bathroom with tub/shower combo for exceptional comfort.Half Bathroom: Conveniently located to serve guests in the living area.Second FloorPrimary Suite: An elegant sanctuary with a lavish king bed, a private en-suite bathroom complete with a tiled shower and access to a serene private balcony.King/Bunk Room: A versatile room offering a king-sized bed and a custom queen-over-queen bunk bed, perfect for families or groups. Includes a private en-suite bathroom with double vanity and walk-in shower.King Guest Bedroom: A sophisticated space with a comfortable king-sized bed, generous room, and a private en-suite bathroom with walk-in shower.*** LOCATION & COMMUNITY ***Situated in a peaceful area of West Panama City Beach, "Shimmy By The Sea" is the perfect getaway, offering easy access to top local attractions and essentials. Whether you’re planning a beach day, exploring nearby parks, or enjoying a night out, everything is within reach!Publix, Aldi, CVS (2 Min)Bayou Bill’s & Waffle House (2 Min)Shops and Restaurants of Carillon Beach (2 Min)Camp Helen State Park (5 Min)30A/Inlet/Rosemary Beaches (7 Min)Pier Park Shopping & Entertainment (10 Min)Northwest Florida Beaches Airport (20 Min)Plus, you're just a 6-minute walk from prime beach access!*** OTHER THINGS TO KNOW ***Travel Insurance is NOT included in our quotes. It can be purchased during the reservation process or independently.We DO NOT accept wire transfers for paymentThe pool cannot be heated.There is ongoing construction across the street with an unknown end date.*** YOUR STAY - OUR PRIORITY ***At 30A Escapes, we’re committed to providing a luxurious, safe, and stress-free vacation experience. Enjoy 24/7 support and an immaculate home designed for comfort and relaxation.*** BOOK TODAY & START YOUR 30A ESCAPE! ***TDT #: 236904STRO #: 48718
